verdicts.explanation: The paper states the Li conductivity of glass-Li3PS4 was estimated as 7.45×10-3 S cm-1 at 300 K via the Nernst-Einstein equation, from its own NNP-MD simulations, so the value, unit, temperature (300 K = 26.85 °C), and computational origin all match.

The value 1.9×10-2 S cm-1 is quoted from previous AIMD work [10] in the results, and the paper gives no temperature for it, so null temperature is correct and literature_cited is a reasonable origin for a cited value.
The value 7.0×10-3 S cm-1 is the second cited value from ref. [10] in the same sentence, with no stated temperature, so null temperature and literature_cited origin match the paper.
The introduction states LGPS exhibits an ionic conductivity of 12 mS cm-1 at room temperature citing [1]; the paper gives no numeric temperature, so a null Celsius value is correct.
